documents.title: Notice Of The 43Rd Annual General Meeting To Be Held On Wednesday, September 30, 2026 And Annual Report For FY 2025-26.
Intimation Of Closure Of Register Of Members And Share Transfer Books / Fixing Of Record Date
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting In Accordance With SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015

analysis.summary: Setco Automotive Limited published its Q1 FY26 investor presentation outlining its operational presence, subsidiary performance, and financial results. Revenue from operations for Q1 FY26 reached Rs. 178.8 crore, marking a 7.8% year-on-year growth compared to Q1 FY25. EBITDA for the quarter stood at Rs. 21.6 crore, representing an 11.9% year-on-year increase driven by higher sales, favourable segment mix, and operational efficiencies.

guidance.claim: The company expects the MHCV industry to grow at an exponential double-digit rate of over 30%.
guidance.quote: MHCV industry is expecting to grow at exponential double digit growth rate of >30%

guidance.claim: Setco sales to OEMs are estimated to be higher than the industry average due to BSVI channel and pipeline inventory restocking.
guidance.quote:
Setco sales to OEM’s estimated will be higher than the industry average due to 
 BSVI Channel and pipeline inventory restocking/build-back 
 Migration to larger size clutches (higher realization per unit) due to BS-VI norms

guidance.claim: Revenue per unit of approximately 25% is expected to remain going forward.
guidance.quote: Revenue per unit of ~25% will remain going forward

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue growth in Q1 FY26 was attributed to continued and robust demand for Setco's products.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue from Operations stood at Rs. 178.8 crore in Q1 FY26, as against Rs. 165.8 crore in Q1 FY25, a growth of 7.8% on a year on year basis, mainly on account of continued and robust demand for Setco’s products

demand_outlook.claim: As the economy unlocks, fleet utilization will progressively improve, leading to higher demand for clutches in the aftermarket.
demand_outlook.quote: As economy gets unlocked, fleet utilization will progressively improve and long delayed repairs/over-hauling will be needed, resulting in higher demand for clutches in the aftermarket in coming years.

demand_outlook.claim: The aftermarket segment experienced an unexecuted strong order book of approximately 6-8 months of sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Unexecuted strong order book approx. 6-8 months of sales

demand_outlook.claim: Heavy allocation in the budget for infrastructure, mining, and the rural sector is expected to lead to a sharp rebound in MHCV OEM.
demand_outlook.quote: Due to heavy allocation in budget for infrastructure, mining and rural sector is expected to lead to sharp rebound in MHCV

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket demand is expected to continue for the foreseeable future as long-overdue replacements come in.
demand_outlook.quote: Long overdue replacement of the past has started coming and expect to continue for the foreseeable future

capex_expansion.claim: Planned maintenance capex for Lava Cast is getting completed by H1FY22 and would result in higher capacity utilization.
capex_expansion.quote: Due to liquidity issues, planned maintenance capex is getting completed by H1FY22 and would result in higher capacity utilization

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY26 EBITDA growth was driven by higher sales, favourable segment mix, and operational efficiencies at Lava Cast and foreign subsidiaries.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the Q1 FY26 is Rs. 21.6 crore as against Rs. 19.3 crore in Q1 FY25, a year on year growth of 11.9%, mainly on account of higher sales, favourable segment mix and higher operational efficiencies at LAVA cast and Foreign subsidiaries

margins_costs.claim: FY25 EBITDA growth was driven by a favourable sales mix, continued operational efficiencies, and the Lava Cast turnaround.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the FY25 is Rs. 109.2 crore as against Rs. 72.5 crore in FY24, a year on year growth of 50.7%, driven by favourable sales mix, continued operational efficiencies and LAVA Cast turnaround during the financial year

margins_costs.claim: Contribution levels reached 22.7% due to higher commodity prices and unfavorable segment mix.
margins_costs.quote: Contribution levels at 22.7% due to higher commodity prices and unfavorable segment mix.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins showed a large downfall at 2.9% in FY21 due to lower operating leverages and a quarter lag on recovering raw material pricing.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins has shown a large downfall at 2.9% in FY21 due to lower operating leverages and quarter lag on recovering RM pricing

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved fixed cost reduction and savings of over 24% in the last two years.
margins_costs.quote: Already achieved Fixed cost reduction /savings of over ~24% in last two years

orders_capacity.claim: Setco continues to retain its market leadership with over 85% market share in the MHCV OEM segment.
orders_capacity.quote: Setco continues to retain its market leadership with >85% market share in MHCV OEM segment.

orders_capacity.claim: Lava Cast capacity utilization reached a maximum of only around 52% with high rejection rates of 17% to 19%.
orders_capacity.quote: Teething problems: LowerCapacity utilization (max achieved is only ~52%) and high rejection rates (~17% - 19%).

orders_capacity.claim: Lava Cast capacity utilization stood at 28% in Q3FY21.

capital_allocation.claim: The India Resurgence Fund investment proposal involves moving down the clutch business into subsidiary Setco Auto Systems Pvt. Ltd through a slump-sale process.
capital_allocation.quote: The Investment Proposal involves moving down the clutch business of the company into the subsidiary Setco Auto Systems Pvt. Ltd through BTA (slump-sale) process

capital_allocation.claim: Investment by India Resurgence Fund will be in a combination of NCDs, CCDs, and Equity.
capital_allocation.quote: Investment will be in the combination of Debentures (NCDs), CCDs and Equity

capital_allocation.claim: The restructuring proposal of bank debt for Lava Cast has been approved and implemented.
capital_allocation.quote: Restructuring proposal of bank has been approved and implemented

risks_headwinds.claim: Lava Cast faced teething problems including low capacity utilization and high rejection rates, resulting in losses.
risks_headwinds.quote: Teething problems: LowerCapacity utilization (max achieved is only ~52%) and high rejection rates (~17% - 19%).

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain constraints affected production during Q3FY21.
risks_headwinds.quote: Q3FY21 would have been much better, but supply chain constraint has affected the production

risks_headwinds.claim: Frequent lockdowns in foreign countries resulted in lower sales and impacted profitability.
risks_headwinds.quote: Frequent lockdown in foreign countries has resulted in lower sales and impacted profitability

management_commitments.claim: Lava Cast commenced export supplies to the US market with initial volumes rolling out.
management_commitments.quote: Commenced export supplies to the US market; initial volumes have started rolling out.

management_commitments.claim: Lava Cast is engaged with potential customers across Europe and the US with multiple RFQs under evaluation.
management_commitments.quote: Engaged with potential customers across Europe and the US, with multiple RFQs under evaluation.

management_commitments.claim: Lava Cast is collaborating with Indian OEMs on new RFQ opportunities to expand domestic engagement.
management_commitments.quote: Collaborating with Indian OEMs on new RFQ opportunities, aiming to expand domestic engagement.

management_commitments.claim: Setco Auto Systems Pvt. Ltd. achieved early success through qualification in an RFQ with a leading US-based aftermarket player.
management_commitments.quote: Increased focus on export markets, with early success through qualification in an RFQ with a leading US based aftermarket player.

management_commitments.claim: Supplies have begun with two products alongside efforts to expand the portfolio to 15 products with a prominent aftermarket customer in Germany.
management_commitments.quote: Supplies have begun with two products; ongoing efforts to expand the portfolio to 15 products with a prominent aftermarket customer in Germany.

management_commitments.claim: Setco is actively exploring opportunities with OEMs in the Netherlands and broader European markets.
management_commitments.quote: Actively exploring opportunities with OEMs in the Netherlands and broader European markets

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to complete all formalities for the fund-raising deal in the next 7-15 days.
management_commitments.quote: Expect to complete all formalities in next 7-15 days.

management_commitments.claim: Business operations are planned for effective and progressive execution over the next 4 years of the growth cycle.
management_commitments.quote: Effective and progressive business operations of the company going forward over the next 4 years of growth cycle

management_commitments.claim: Management has planned its growth strategy for the next 5 years around large and growing aftermarket potential, and initial success in the farm business and exports.
management_commitments.quote:
Large and growing aftermarket potential, initial success in farm business & exports are 
opportunities on which we have planned our growth strategy for the next 5 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to start farm equipment supplies with a few other OEMs in the next 3-4 months.
management_commitments.quote: Farm equipment : Sales started with 2 OEM’s, expects to start with few others in next 3-4 months

management_commitments.claim: The scrappage policy will come into effect from April 2022 to boost demand.
management_commitments.quote: Long awaited scrappage policy coming into effect from April 2022 will boost the demand

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
